default_lease_time.description: Lease length in seconds when the client asks for none.

max_lease_time.description: Longest lease in seconds a client may get.

ddns_update_style.description: Dynamic DNS updates on lease (dhcpd.conf(5)): none, interim or standard.

authoritative.description: This server is the official DHCP server for its networks (answers DHCPNAK to foreign leases). Unset keeps the shipped line.

range_start.description: First address handed out (omit for a declared-only subnet)

subnets.description: The subnets dhcpd serves: network, netmask, and optionally a range, routers and DNS servers. At least one must contain an address of one of the host's interfaces — dhcpd refuses to start otherwise ("No subnet declaration for <interface>"). A site value: the role asks for it before deploying.
